reviews.title: I’m being ripped off against my will

For something I have to PAY FOR to watch a D3 game of my own school, it is the most frustrating app ever. Good luck trying to watch a game on their website because you’ll get kicked off every 10 minutes, the game will glitch, or it suddenly can’t load and you have to close out the site. I got the app because of how frustrating the site was, and while it was a little better, it STILL freezed up and I STILL got kicked out of the app multiple times in one game. All of my friends and their parents hate using it too but we literally have no choice, and on top of that we have no choice but to pay way more than it’s worth. Because of all the complaints, I feel that my school will not use it again next year. I pray they don’t.

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointed – Unacceptable Streaming Reliability
reviews.text:
I can honestly say that FloSports is the most unreliable streaming service I have ever used. The constant interruptions and recurring technical difficulties have made watching events an exercise in frustration rather than enjoyment.

During the last three games I attempted to watch, I would wager that my screen displayed “Technical Difficulties” more often than it actually streamed the events. This is simply unacceptable for a paid subscription service.

I subscribed to FloSports for one primary reason: to enjoy watching my son compete in his athletic events, particularly when I cannot be there in person. Instead, what should be an enjoyable experience has repeatedly turned into an evening of frustration and disappointment.

In fact, my son is playing right now as I write this review. Unfortunately, I have so little confidence in the reliability of FloSports at this point that I know I’m not missing anything by not watching. The service is so consistently unreliable that the game would likely be unwatchable anyway.

Customers pay for a service with the reasonable expectation that it will work. Occasional technical issues are understandable. Persistent interruptions that prevent customers from watching the very events they subscribed to see are not.

FloSports needs to take a serious look at the quality and reliability of its streaming platform. This isn’t a minor inconvenience; it’s a failure to deliver the service customers are paying for.

reviews.title: Billing
reviews.text:
I would recommend staying away from Flow Sport unless you’re prepared for a subscription that may be more difficult to cancel than expected.

About six months before my membership was even set to renew, I canceled it through my Apple ID and assumed everything was taken care of. Despite that, when my renewal date came around, Flow Sport attempted to charge my card anyway. When the first attempt failed, they tried again multiple times.

To make sure there wasn’t an issue on my end, I logged into their website, confirmed my Apple subscription had already been canceled, and canceled anything I could find on their website as well. I then contacted their support through their contact form and clearly explained that I no longer wanted the service and asked them to stop attempting to bill my card.

The next day, instead of receiving confirmation that the issue had been resolved, I started getting emails asking how my conversations with support representatives had gone. The problem is, I never spoke with anyone. Everything was handled through online forms and email. There were no actual conversations with the people they referenced.

All I wanted was for my subscription to be canceled and for them to stop trying to charge my card. Based on my experience, the cancellation process was frustrating, confusing, and left me with very little confidence that my account had actually been closed.

reviews.title: Great concept Poor execution
reviews.text:
Love the idea of being able to watch my Daughters play at games where we cannot attend. There are several improvements that need made for this to bean option to keep paying for once they are done. 
Better search capabilities:
There is past games mixed in with current games and future games. I’ve had to search for an opponent to be able to watch
Poor technical: broadcasts not starting on time or not streaming at all.

reviews.title: Commercials interrupt an active inning for paid service
reviews.text:
I can understand a commercial before and after or if done properly between innings, but all season commercials have been randomly popping up in the middle of the inning. Maybe this is normal for FloSports, but I’ve never seen it on any other subscriber based system.
I put in a support ticket and all I get is something like we’re trying to make it better. How about just stop mid inning advertisements until you figure it out. The shameful thing is its only for FloSports to bring in more revenue. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: No google login for app
reviews.text: I bought a subscription and made my account with the google login online. I can watch online and login to Flo with my google account but on the app there’s no google login option. When I put my same google email and password into the login boxes it doesn’t work. There’s no possible way for me to log in on the app. $30 a month and they can’t even fix this small bug issue. I saw another reviewer had the same issue months ago. I wish I read it before paying for this subscription. I’m canceling my account this month.

reviews.title: Too many commercials and technical difficulties
reviews.text:
2026 review thus far- still terrible. $150, and now unlike last year, only ONE of us can watch at a time. My husband and I can’t watch from different places? Same household, same bank account, same phone account etc. That’s crazy. You want $300 for 2 accounts so we can both watch when 1 of us isn’t home? Still too many commercials! Anytime I leave the screen for any reason and come back, I need to watch 2 more commercials? Also, is SUPER glitchy. Always seems to happen at an intense moment of the game too. Go figure. And who is supposed to be doing the scoreboard? I wish we had another option to watch my daughter’s games. Because this app is terrible.


2025 review-Paid $150 for the year and STILL have commercials? Ridiculous! And the commercials come on in the middle of an at bat?!?!? Constantly has technical difficulties, requiring us to exit app and go back in, then watch more commercials before getting us back to the game! Unfortunately it’s the only way to watch my daughter’s college games.

reviews.title: Rated 1 star because I can’t rate 0 or below
reviews.text: As a D3 sports fan, going from free streams to Flo sports I expected that the quality of the streams would at least improve in some way - but it’s just the opposite. Every other stream that I watch has buffering or technical issues. You have to watch commercials when you log into a game. So basically you’re paying for a worse product and to have to watch commercials. I also want direct video links to the game. Instead you have a link to go to Flo and then have to search for the game. Free and accessible streams for families trying to support their kids or pay for bad streams with Flo sports.

reviews.title: Unbelievably terrible customer service.
reviews.text: Even in an era of poor customer service, this company has figured out a way to go even lower. I have an invoice that plainly states that I would not be charged when my subscription ended. I WAS charged for a full additional year and their response was I will continue to have access to the content for this additional year and hoped I enjoy it. I was warned to avoid this company like the plague. I wish I had heeded that advice. I wish I could go lower than zero stars. Sign me disgusted.

reviews.title: The is app is horrible
reviews.text: I have had flowrestling before and it was working perfectly. I just updated the app on Friday and now it is basically frozen. I can’t scroll down on the pages. So if I don’t see what I want to click on the screen I can’t scroll down to get to it. For instance with finding a bracket my daughter is 235 but I can get to her bracket cause I can’t scroll down on the app and on the screen when I click on brackets I can only see up to 165 so I can’t click to get into the 235 bracket. The same goes for trying to scroll to the different mat numbers for the matches. I wish I can uninstall this update and go back to the version I had before that actually worked and let me scroll through it. Very frustrating and very upset

reviews.title: Commercials and advertisements
reviews.text:
At least two or three times a game , live play will be interrupted by a commercial roll of at least five minutes, this is very frustrating and not what I expected. I understand add rolls during time outs and ice clearing breaks, totally normal and acceptable. The five minute breaks during game play is completely unacceptable especially seeing I pay thirty something a month for this app. I have reached out to flow hockey and I get the normal response. “ we are editor providing the best experience possible, adds and commercials are part of the experience “ . 
 I don’t feel the same way , if there was an alternative to flow hockey I’d cancel both of my subscriptions immediately, currently it’s the only way that I have to catch ECHL, ACHL games.

reviews.title: Amateur product at pro price
reviews.text:
We use this to watch a D3 school we’re interested in - the conference appears to have a contract with Flo. 
For the significant subscription fee, the production quality is low. They often use an automated camera mounted on the gym wall which doesn’t always follow the action. Worse is the commentary. There’s at least 1 and sometimes both commentators are obvious amateurs; the “color” person often has little to say, or not much of value. And then the commentators don’t know if they’re live on air or not during timeouts so we hear their chitchat or production logistics - like when the color wasn’t sure if she was doing a good job and play by play was encouraging her. 
That’s all somewhat understandable if it’s free…but I am paying. 
I’d rather watch like last year - a livestream with the audio piped in from the local radio announcers - at least they know the team & sport and are professional experienced broadcasters.

reviews.title: So bad
reviews.text: Truly the worst streaming service I’ve ever used. I rarely watch a game that doesn’t have some kind of technical difficulty that causes me to miss a major portion of the game. The people operating the cameras clearly have no idea what they are doing, they are constantly switching angles mid play which causes you to miss the actual play itself. There is nothing consistent about the sound, it cuts out the entire game. And the score bar at the bottom of the screen early has the correct time as the actual game clock. This streaming service is the worst part about basketball season.
